# m.reference.ticker_details

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

One ticker's company and listing details: address, branding, shares, and more.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.reference.ticker_details(symbols, *, as_of=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers of any asset class. `dm.ALL` is refused; `tickers()` lists every ticker. |
| [`as_of`](README.md#as_of) | The day the details are as of. Leave it out for the latest. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Ticker Overview (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | crypto: Updated as needed, 2 years; forex: Updated hourly, 2 years |
| Currencies Starter | crypto: Updated as needed, All history; forex: Updated hourly, All history |
| Currencies Business | crypto: Updated as needed, All history; forex: Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Basic | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Starter | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Advanced | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Business | Updated hourly, All history |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `Active` | Boolean | Whether or not the asset is actively traded. False means the asset has been delisted. |
| `AddressAddress1` | String | The first line of the company's headquarters address. From the `address` object: Company headquarters address details. |
| `AddressAddress2` | String | The second line of the company's headquarters address, if applicable. From the `address` object: Company headquarters address details. |
| `AddressCity` | String | The city of the company's headquarters address. From the `address` object: Company headquarters address details. |
| `AddressPostalCode` | String | The postal code of the company's headquarters address. From the `address` object: Company headquarters address details. |
| `AddressState` | String | The state of the company's headquarters address. From the `address` object: Company headquarters address details. |
| `BrandingIconUrl` | String | A link to this ticker's company's icon. Icon's are generally smaller, square images that represent the company at a glance. Note that you must provide an API key when accessing this URL. See the "Authentication" section at the top of this page for more details. From the `branding` object: Provides URLs aiding in visual identification. |
| `BrandingLogoUrl` | String | A link to this ticker's company's logo. Note that you must provide an API key when accessing this URL. See the "Authentication" section at the top of this page for more details. From the `branding` object: Provides URLs aiding in visual identification. |
| `Cik` | String | The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key). |
| `CompositeFigi` | String | The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) |
| `CurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is traded with. |
| `DelistedUtc` | Instant | The last date that the asset was traded. |
| `Description` | String | A description of the company and what they do/offer. |
| `HomepageUrl` | String | The URL of the company's website homepage. |
| `ListDate` | String | The date the security currently trading under this ticker was first publicly listed, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. If a corporate action replaces the security behind the ticker, such as American Depositary Shares being exchanged for ordinary shares under the same symbol, this is the new security's listing date. A move to a different exchange does not change it. Use the date parameter to get the value as of an earlier date. |
| `Locale` | String | The locale of the asset. |
| `Market` | String | The market type of the asset. |
| `MarketCap` | double | The most recent close price of the ticker multiplied by weighted outstanding shares. |
| `Name` | String | The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair. |
| `PhoneNumber` | String | The phone number for the company behind this ticker. |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset. |
| `RoundLot` | double | Round lot size of this security. |
| `ShareClassFigi` | String | The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) |
| `ShareClassSharesOutstanding` | double | The recorded number of outstanding shares for this particular share class. |
| `SicCode` | String | The standard industrial classification code for this ticker. For a list of SIC Codes, see the SEC's SIC Code List (https://www.sec.gov/info/edgar/siccodes.htm). |
| `SicDescription` | String | A description of this ticker's SIC code. |
| `TickerRoot` | String | The root of a specified ticker. For example, the root of BRK.A is BRK. |
| `TickerSuffix` | String | The suffix of a specified ticker. For example, the suffix of BRK.A is A. |
| `TotalEmployees` | double | The approximate number of employees for the company. |
| `Type` | String | The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our Ticker Types API (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types). |
| `WeightedSharesOutstanding` | double | The shares outstanding calculated assuming all shares of other share classes are converted to this share class. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
